w:r.w:t: This Software Design Description (SDD) presents the overall system design and implementation structure of Add-Venture, a mobile-based adaptive game-based learning application for Grade 1 learners. The document describes the system architecture, components, user interface design, object-oriented models, and data structures that guide software implementation and development activities.

The purpose of the Add-Venture project is to provide an adaptive game-based learning application designed to improve foundational single-digit addition skills among Grade 1 learners through guided strategies, interactive activities, progression-based learning, and performance monitoring. The system is designed to implement Count All, Count On, and Number Bonds learning strategies through interactive gameplay mechanics, adaptive features, and learner progress monitoring to support engaging and personalized learning experiences.

Add-Venture is a standalone Android mobile application designed using the MVVM architectural pattern to provide adaptive and interactive learning experiences for Grade 1 learners. The application implements Count All, Count On, and Number Bonds strategies through progression-based gameplay, adaptive learning mechanisms, guided hints, learner progress tracking, and performance monitoring features.

3.2 Adjust Difficulty Based on Learner Performance

enders activity layouts with dynamically adjusted difficulty and repeated practice tasks based on learner performance and mastery level. The system may present similar activity patterns or quantity combinations when learners demonstrate difficulty in completing previous tasks correctly.

Evaluates learner accuracy, response patterns, and repeated mistakes from previous activity attempts. When learners struggle with specific quantity combinations or activity patterns, the system generates similar follow-up activities for reevaluation and continued practice. Difficulty gradually increases only after repeated successful activity completion with satisfactory accuracy performance.
